meta.title: Example A — Nested vault (synthetic)
meta.description: A user deposits Token U into a vault, the vault issues vU shares, a keeper allocates the idle assets to a strategy that issues sU shares to the vault and supplies the assets to an external lending market L (receipt lU). Redemption unwinds the layers.

source.snippet: IERC20 public immutable asset;            // Token U (example)

mapping(address => uint256) public balanceOf;   // vU shares
    uint256 public totalSupply;
ExampleStrategy public strategy;          // bound by configuration
require(assets > 0, "zero");
shares = supply == 0 ? assets : assets * supply / totalAssets();
asset.transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), assets);
_mint(msg.sender, shares);
require(amount <= asset.balanceOf(address(this)), "idle");
asset.transfer(address(strategy), amount);
strategy.deposit(amount);
assets = shares * totalAssets() / totalSupply;
_burn(msg.sender, shares);
asset.transfer(msg.sender, assets);

mapping(address => uint256) public balanceOf;   // sU shares
    uint256 public totalSupply;

totalSupply += shares;
        balanceOf[vault] += shares;
market.supply(address(asset), amount, address(this));

balanceOf[vault] -= shares;
        totalSupply -= shares;
asset.transfer(vault, amount);

/// Pulls `amount` of `token` from msg.sender and credits receipt tokens (lU) to `onBehalfOf`.
    function supply(address token, uint256 amount, address onBehalfOf) external;

/// Burns receipt tokens of msg.sender and sends `amount` of `token` to `to`.
    function withdraw(address token, uint256 amount, address to) external returns (uint256);

tasks.question: Who actually holds the Token U after a deposit and an allocation?
tasks.answer: ExampleVault (idle), ExampleStrategy (idle) and lending market L (supplied). The user holds vU shares — a claim on these positions, not Token U itself.

tasks.question: What does the user's vU position represent, and which positions back it?
tasks.answer: A pro-rata claim on ExampleVault.totalAssets(): idle U in the vault plus sU held by the vault, which in turn claims idle U in the strategy and lU at market L.

tasks.question: Which contracts and protocols does the vU share depend on?
tasks.answer: ExampleStrategy (totalAssets) and, through sU, lending market L, whose implementation is outside the analysis scope.

tasks.question: Which operations are needed to exit a vU position and who performs them?
tasks.answer: The holder calls redeem; the vault may call strategy.withdraw if idle U is insufficient; the strategy may withdraw from market L; the vault pays U to the holder. All in one transaction.

tasks.question: Which steps were observed in a transaction and which are only static candidates?
tasks.answer: Deposit and allocate were observed (synthetic traces); redeem and the market-L withdrawal are static candidates.
